title: Control Systems Engineer
description:
Join our team as a Control Systems Engineer and be at the forefront of designing, developing, and optimizing complex electrical and automation systems. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in electrical engineering, system design, and containerized industrial software to create reliable control solutions for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Power Plant Controllers (PPC). Your contributions will directly impact the efficiency, safety, and performance of our advanced Energy Management Systems (EMS), driving technological progress and operational excellence in the renewable energy sector.

Responsibilities

* EMS/PPC Design: Design Power Plant Control logic to manage frequency regulation, voltage support, and peak shaving for utility\-scale BESS.
* PLC and Edge Development: Design and maintain robust control logic within CODESYS and develop detailed control architectures utilizing SoC and programmable logic controllers.
* SCADA and Visualization: Design high\-performance HMI and data dashboards using Ignition (Perspective/Vision).
* Edge Orchestration: Design and manage edge computing workloads and clusters using K3s (lightweight Kubernetes) and Docker.
* Integration and Communication: Design and troubleshoot industrial protocol interfaces including Modbus TCP/RTU and OPC UA.
* Automation and Firmware: Implement software solutions in Python and C\+\+ for data processing, automated testing, and custom EMS middleware.
* Hardware Integration: Design and analyze electrical schematics using SolidWorks to ensure seamless integration of hardware components and BESS infrastructure.
* Testing and Validation: Conduct root cause analysis on system failures using debugging tools such as oscilloscopes and signal processing techniques; perform simulations to validate design concepts before deployment.
* Project Management: Collaborate with teams to develop project schedules, manage milestones, and ensure timely delivery of control system components.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/ Position Overview We are seeking a SVP/VP/Director of Product to lead the product strategy, portfolio, commercialization, and team development for our AI cloud infrastructure platform. Centered on GPU cloud computing, this role will oversee the development of our cloud infrastructure, AI training and inference platforms, and related product capabilities. The VP will be responsible for transforming the company’s global data center and GPU resources into a unified, standardized, and scalable AI cloud platform. The ideal candidate brings experience from a leading public cloud provider, GPU cloud platform, or neocloud company. This individual should combine a strong understanding of cloud and AI infrastructure with the ability to develop product strategy, identify market opportunities, lead product teams, and drive execution across functions. Key Responsibilities Define the overall product strategy, product architecture, and long-term roadmap for the company’s AI cloud platform, including market positioning, core product offerings, and investment priorities. Lead the product portfolio across GPU compute, bare metal, containers, networking, storage, resource management, and shared cloud platform capabilities.
